definitions.explanation: Acting or speaking without careful consideration of the consequences.

examples.japanese: {軽率|けいそつ}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: His thoughtless remarks caused a problem.

examples.japanese: {軽率|けいそつ}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦べき→べき：10016_beki⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{軽率|けいそつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{約束|やくそく}して→約束する：01517_yakusoku⟧⟦しまった→しまう：03064_shimau⟧。

notes:
FORMS:
- {軽率|けいそつ}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧ + noun (adnominal)
- {軽率|けいそつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (adverbial)
- {軽率|けいそつ}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ (predicative)
{軽|けい} (light) + {率|そつ} (rate, lead) - originally meaning "leading lightly" without due caution

USAGE:
Negative connotation. Used to criticize careless behavior:
- {軽率|けいそつ}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧ (hasty judgment)
- {軽率|けいそつ}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (thoughtless attitude)
- {軽率|けいそつ}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧ (careless response)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{浅|あさ}はか→浅はか：13313_asahaka⟧ - shallow, thoughtless
- ⟦{無謀|むぼう}→無謀：13423_mubou⟧ - reckless, rash
- ⟦{短絡的|たんらくてき}→短絡的：20703_tanrakuteki⟧ - simplistic, short-sighted
